name: Hyperliquid HLP
notes: HLP is a protocol vault on Hyperliquid L1 (HyperCore), accessed via Hyperliquid's off-chain REST/WS API, not EVM events. Official hyperliquid-dex org has no HLP indexer/subgraph. Only community analysis tools (StreetJammer/hyperliquid-vault-analyzer, thunderhead-labs/hyperliquid-stats) that consume the API, not a public indexer of this protocol. No public indexer found.

name: Lightning Network
notes: Bitcoin Lightning Network (off-chain payment channels on Bitcoin). Not an EVM protocol; no subgraph/indexer-style repo applicable. No public indexer found.

name: Nexo
notes: Custodial CeFi lending/exchange. Publishes proof-of-reserves attestations but no public subgraph/indexer git repo. No public indexer found.

name: BounceBit CeDeFi Yield
notes: BounceBit-Labs org has chain-node/SDK repos (bouncebit-chain-node, bitswap_v2/v3_sdk, btcstake) but no subgraph/indexer for the CeDeFi yield product. No public indexer found.

name: Aave Horizon RWA

repos.scope: Official config-driven Aave V3 subgraph codebase. Horizon is an Aave v3.3 market (contracts at aave/aave-v3-horizon) indexable via the same subgraph; a Horizon-specific deployment config was not explicitly confirmed in-repo.
repos.verified: WebFetch github repo: active public TypeScript subgraph (AGPL-3.0, 279 commits, ongoing) indexing Aave V3 across many networks/markets incl. branded variants (GHO, Lido, Etherfi). Horizon is the RWA market variant of Aave v3.3 (separate aave/aave-v3-horizon contracts repo).

notes: Aave Horizon = Aave v3.3 RWA market (contracts: aave/aave-v3-horizon). Official Aave subgraph repo indexes Aave V3 and is the natural/official indexer for Horizon, though a dedicated Horizon market config in the public repo was not explicitly verified.

name: PancakeSwap AMM V3

repos.scope: PancakeSwap V3 exchange: Factory (PoolCreated), pools, swaps, mints, burns, ticks, NonfungiblePositionManager positions across BSC, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Linea, zkSync Era, Polygon zkEVM, opBNB, Scroll.
repos.verified: git clone --depth 1: template/subgraph.template.yaml defines V3 Factory + NonfungiblePositionManager dataSources; schema.graphql has Pool/Tick/Position/Mint/Burn/Swap entities; config/ holds per-chain v3 factoryAddress for bsc, ethereum, arbitrum, base, linea, zksync-era, polygon-zkevm, opbnb, scroll.

notes: Official PancakeSwap V3 subgraph (The Graph Studio). Companion repo pancakeswap/pancake-subgraph covers blocks/prediction/NFT.

name: Phemex
notes: Custodial centralized exchange. No public on-chain subgraph/indexer repo. No public indexer found.

name: Linea Bridge
notes: Canonical L1<->Linea bridge. Bridge/messaging code lives in Consensys/linea-monorepo (contracts, coordinator, postman) - no dedicated public subgraph/indexer for bridge state. Linea docs tell devs to build their own subgraph. No official bridge indexer repo found.

name: Dswap
notes: DAOaaS Dswap, a DEX on the ENI chain (daoaas.io). No public git repo, subgraph, or indexer found for this protocol/chain. No public indexer found.

name: CIAN Yield Layer
notes: CIAN exposes a private vault-history REST API (docs.cian.app) for tvl/apy/holders, but no public subgraph/indexer git repo and no public CIAN GitHub org with indexer code. No public indexer found.

name: Euler V2

repos.scope: Euler V2 (EVK vaults, EVC, EulerSwap) across Ethereum mainnet, Base, Arbitrum, Swell, Sonic, Ink, Berachain, Bob, Unichain, Avalanche, BSC.
repos.verified: WebFetch github repo: contains schema.graphql + generated subgraph.yaml, /contracts and /abis dirs, multi-network deploy scripts; official euler-xyz org repo, updated May 2026 (84 commits on simple-subgraph branch). docs.euler.finance references this as the official subgraph incl. eulerSwapPools/eulerSwaps queries.

notes: Official Euler Labs subgraph repo; docs.euler.finance points to it. Subgraphs also hosted on Goldsky and The Graph.

name: Free Protocol
notes: FreeLayer2 cross-chain bridge (Merlin/Ethereum/BSC/Arbitrum/etc.). No public GitHub org/repo with a subgraph or indexer found. No public indexer found.

name: Bedrock uniBTC
notes: Bedrock-Technology/uniBTC is public but smart contracts only (Solidity 83% / Python; ccip/celer/oft cross-chain dirs); no subgraph.yaml/schema.graphql/ponder. No public indexer found.

name: Coinbase Wrapped Staked ETH
notes: cbETH is an ERC-20 wrapped staked-ETH token; Coinbase open-sourced the token contracts (wrapped-tokens-os) but there is no dedicated public subgraph/indexer for cbETH. No public indexer found.

name: Re
notes: Re (re.xyz) tokenized reinsurance (reUSD). No official public subgraph/indexer repo found; rwa.xyz lists Re but is a third-party analytics platform, not Re's own indexer. No public indexer found.

name: cap
notes: cap-labs-dev org (cap-contracts, cap-docs, cap-yearn-strategies, cap-audits, etc.) has no subgraph/indexer/ponder repo. NB: an unrelated older perp protocol '0xcap' has CAP v1/v3.1 subgraphs - NOT this cap.app stablecoin/lending protocol. No public indexer for cap.app found.

name: xDAI Stake Bridge
notes: Canonical ETH<->Gnosis(xDai) token bridge. Official omni/tokenbridge monorepo uses an Oracle/Monitor architecture, NOT a subgraph (verified: no subgraph.yaml/schema.graphql). Community xdai-omnibridge repos are mostly UI forks of the (separate) OmniBridge. No official bridge subgraph/indexer found.

name: Orca DEX
notes: Orca Whirlpools is a Solana/Eclipse concentrated-liquidity AMM (program repo orca-so/whirlpools, Rust). Not indexable via The Graph subgraphs; only a Subsquid SQD docs tutorial exists for indexing Whirlpool txs (example/tutorial, not a maintained protocol indexer repo). No official public indexer repo found.

name: Upshift
notes: Upshift vaults are powered by August Digital, which runs 2 'Lending Pools' subgraphs (Ethereum + Arbitrum) on The Graph (docs.augustdigital.io/developers/subgraphs) - hosted query endpoints only, no public source git repo located. No public indexer repo found.

name: Fluid DEX
notes: Instadapp/fluid-contracts-public is contracts only. A Fluid governance bounty 'Build the Instadapp Subgraph' is marked in-progress (no public repo linked). Existing instadapp-*-subgraph repos (protofire, PierrickGT) index legacy DSA smart accounts, NOT the Fluid DEX. No public Fluid DEX indexer found.

name: B2 Buzz
notes: B2 Network canonical BTC bridge. b2network/Buzz-Core is Solidity contracts only (verified). A b2-indexer Go package was referenced historically but is no longer publicly accessible (WebFetch 404, not in org repo search). No public indexer found.

name: Stader
notes: stader-labs org (38 repos) has only protocol/contract repos (ethx, maticX, bnbX, nearx, stader-node) and one sftmx-subgraph-one for the unrelated/legacy sFTMx product; no subgraph/indexer matches for ETHx liquid staking (org search for 'graph'/'subgraph' returns 0). No public indexer for the main Stader LST products found.

name: AFI Protocol
notes: Artificial-Financial-Intelligence org has only contract/lib repos (afiUSD ERC4626 vault, por-proof-verifier-script, pendle fork); the separate AFI-Protocol org has agentic logic repos (afi-core, afi-math). No subgraph/indexer/ponder repo. No public indexer found.

name: BitFi Basis
notes: BitFi (bitfi.one) basis-trading product. No public GitHub org/repo with subgraph or indexer found (the unrelated 'Bitfi' GitHub org is a hardware-wallet company). No public indexer found.

name: GTBTC
notes: GTBTC is Gate exchange's custodial BTC staking/restaking product (gate.com/staking/BTC). Custodial, Bitcoin-side; no public on-chain subgraph/indexer repo. No public indexer found.
